description: Kill Switch | Tech Fusion-2026 Organized By: Vaish College of Engineering, Rohtak Event: Tech Fusion-2026 – Inter-College Techno-Management Fest About The Competition: One system. Multiple threats. One mission: take control before it's too late. Kill Switch is a high-energy technical challenge designed to test participants' cybersecurity awareness, logical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and decision-making under pressure. Participants will face technical challenges involving security scenarios, digital clues, system vulnerabilities, and time-sensitive problems. They must analyze the available information, identify potential risks, and determine the correct course of action to complete their mission. The competition focuses on analytical thinking, technical knowledge, accuracy, and the ability to make smart decisions when every second counts. Who Can Participate? Eligibility, team size, and participation rules will be specified by the organizers in the final competition guidelines. What To Expect: Cybersecurity-themed challenges and technical problem-solving. Logical reasoning and analysis of digital clues. Time-bound tasks that test accuracy and decision-making. An engaging competitive environment for technology enthusiasts. Competition Rules: Participants must follow all instructions provided by the organizers. Only organizer-provided or explicitly authorized systems and resources may be used. Unauthorized access to external systems, networks, or accounts is prohibited. Unfair practices or attempts to interfere with other participants may result in disqualification. The competition format, duration, scoring criteria, and team rules will be announced by the organizers. Get ready to analyze, strategize, and execute. Stay sharp, trust the evidence, and activate your Kill Switch at the right moment.
